message.content: LeBron James is an American professional basketball player widely regarded as one of the greatest players in NBA history. He was born on December 30, 1984, in Akron, Ohio, and played high school basketball at St. Vincent‑St. Mary High School, where he gained national attention. LeBron was drafted first overall by the Cleveland Cavaliers in 2003, then played for the Miami Heat (2010–2014), returned to the Cavaliers (2014–2018), joined the Los Angeles Lakers (2018–present), and has won four NBA championships (2007, 2012, 2013, 2020). He has earned numerous accolades, including four NBA Most Valuable Player awards, 17 All‑NBA selections, and 13 NBA All‑Star appearances. Off the court, LeBron is known for his philanthropy, notably the LeBron James Family Foundation, and for his media ventures, such as the production company SpringHill Entertainment.
